slides.title: RLS Career Overhaul v2.7.1.1 Beta
slides.subtitle: Beta, September 2026
slides.summary: Company jobs, independent hauling, businesses to own, and new places on West Coast.

slides.title: Get hired at BPS or Fink Industries
slides.summary: Clock in, drive their trucks, get paid at the end of the shift.
facts: Employment app preinstalled; Hiring Now lists open jobs
Company trucks, trailers and fuel; pay held until the run is done
Parcels, trailers, materials and car hauling in one shift
Headhunters call at skill milestones; miss three days and you're out

slides.title: Job Broker: haul on your own terms
slides.summary: Independent work from the phone, with rigs for rent at Commercial Vehicle Sales.
facts: Six markets, from parcels to car hauling and specialty cargo
Sort by pay or distance; hold up to five loads at once
Rent trucks and trailers by the hour, return them to the depot

slides.title: Own West Coast Engine Works
slides.summary: Buy the shop, certify blueprints, run the lines, sell engines from the storefront.
facts: Sales screen shows cost, market value, profit and daily demand
Dyno sessions: $1,000 for three pulls, no tire wear, tunes saved to the library

slides.title: Seventeen storefronts to keep stocked
slides.summary: Mini marts, cafes, nail salons, jewelers and gift shops across West Coast.
facts: Nine business types, each with its own supply needs
Haul supplies from inspect spots to your own shop
Dashboards show profit per pallet and per hour, and payback

slides.title: Tractor pulls, cleanups and police duty
slides.summary: Three new ways to spend a day.
facts: Tractor Pull: sleds from 8,000 to 30,000 lb, 300 ft full pull, up to $4,000
Cleanup Club: clear sites for parts, cash or a project car
Police duty tracks arrests and BOLOs in the task list

slides.title: New places on the map
slides.summary: A ferry terminal on the shoreline and a hilltop cafe, both built from new custom models.
facts: Ferry terminal with its own approach road and gates
Dino Cafe and shop, lit up after dark
Engine Works building and the tractor pull arena
